channel.title: UniKloSwitcher Updates
channel.description: Most recent updates for UniKloSwitcher keyboard switcher.

item.title: UniKloSwitcher 1.3.12
item.description:
• Tray icon blink (accent-tinted) on every layout switch and conversion; icon reflects the auto-switch state.
  • New tray and app icons (keyboard glyph family).
  • Permission preflight at startup: both Accessibility and Input Monitoring are requested explicitly, with automatic pane navigation and per-second retry supervisor — no app relaunch needed after granting.
  • Diagnostic logging of service lifecycle (no user text in release builds).
  • Front-app exclusion menu now uses explicit verbs: «Disable for …» / «Enable for …».
  • Update server and release repository moved to uniKloSwitcher-app.
  • Permissions no longer break after rebuilds: stable code-signing identity is now embedded in TCC records.
  • macOS 15: menu bar icon visibility for LSUIElement apps and settings window activation.
  • Clipboard save/restore no longer materializes file-promise pasteboard content.

item.title: UniKloSwitcher 1.3.28
item.description:
Added

  • Contextual chaining for short words and prepositions (`ShortWords` registry for RU and EN): mistyped short words (e.g. «nj » → «то ») and single-letter prepositions («d » → «в ») are safely held as candidates and converted together when confirmed by the following word («nj есть» → «то есть», «d дороге» → «в дороге», «шт the» → «in the»).
  • Bidirectional chaining support across Russian and English layouts.

Fixed

  • False auto-switch triggers and keystroke corruption when typing valid Russian words:
  • Keys carrying Cyrillic letters that map to punctuation on US layout (б, ю, ж, э, х, ъ) no longer leak Cyrillic letters into the destination accumulation buffer.
  • Added strict guards preventing word self-conversion (`rawWord != dstWord`) and requiring distinct scripts (`rawScript != dstScript`).
  • Active and target layouts are now resolved directly from the physically typed script on screen.
  • Backspacing immediately after an uncommitted short word now safely resets the preposition chain buffer.

item.title: UniKloSwitcher 1.4.3
item.description:
Added

  • Native macOS menu bar layout badge indicator (`EN`, `RU`, etc.): filled plate with cutout text when active, outline plate when paused, disabled, or dormant on an unsupported layout; accent-color flash on layout switch. Configurable in Settings → General («Menu Bar Icon Style: Layout Badge / Keyboard»).
  • Multi-layout safety gate (3+ layouts): auto-switch and hotkey word conversion strictly engage only when the active layout is English or Russian, leaving 3rd-party layouts (e.g. `de`, `uk`, `fr`) completely untouched.

Fixed

  • Calibrated trigram threshold (`minTargetScore = -3.8`) allowing tech terms and loanwords with rare Cyrillic trigrams (such as `,tql;` → `бейдж`) to auto-convert seamlessly.
  • Menu bar layout badge proportions refined: narrower width and taller height matching native macOS capsule controls.

item.title: UniKloSwitcher 1.5.2
item.description:
Added

  • Secure Input Protection & HUD Notice**: Complete isolation of password and terminal `sudo` sessions via `IsSecureEventInputEnabled()` and IOKit process resolution (`kCGSSessionSecureInputPID`). Auto-switching and hotkey conversions immediately bail without touching password fields, and an unobtrusive, click-through non-activating HUD overlay informs the user.
  • Bilingual Localization (EN / RU)**: Automatic system language detection (`Locale.current`) with manual language override in Settings (`System / English / Русский`). Full 100% localization across HUD notices, menu bar items, tooltips, and all 4 Settings tabs (`General`, `Auto-Switch`, `Hotkeys`, `About`).
  • Extended Pause Options**: Added «Until Tomorrow» (`pauseUntilTomorrow`) and clarified pause durations in the menu bar (`15 Minutes`, `30 Minutes`, `1 Hour`, `Until Tomorrow`).
  • HUD Preview Button**: Interactive test button in Settings → General to preview the Secure Input notice layout and typography directly on screen.

Changed

  • Secure Input HUD Typography & Layout**: Compact, focused HUD linked directly to macOS system typography (`NSFont.systemFontSize`), featuring a security shield icon, concise scannable copy, and a non-activating `.statusBar` floating window level.

Fixed

  • Asymmetric Fail-Closed Secure Input Cache**: Cached `true` for 100ms during active password typing to eliminate WindowServer IPC overhead, while never caching `false` (0ms lag when entering password fields).
  • Third-Party & Alternative Layouts**: Unified layout support under a single core predicate `isLayoutSupported` shared by both auto-switch and manual hotkeys, fully supporting 3rd-party Cyrillic layouts lacking TIS language tags (e.g. Ilya Birman Typography).
  • Clean UI Layout Codes (`displayLanguageCode`)**: Introduced robust 2-letter uppercase display code resolution for menu bar badges and floating language chips, permanently eliminating `?→?` notices on layouts with missing TIS language tags.
  • AX Messaging Timeout**: Applied strict 0.25s timeouts on accessibility queries to prevent beachballs when interacting with unresponsive applications.
  • Language Detection Fallback**: Aligned system language resolution so non-Russian system locales fall back cleanly to English standard interface, with reactive Settings window title updates upon language change.

item.title: UniKloSwitcher 1.5.3
item.description:
Fixed

  • Slash as Word Boundary**: Added slash (`/`) as a recognized word boundary trigger in the auto-correction engine. Mistyped words followed immediately by a slash (e.g. `yfcnhjqrb/разработки`) now convert instantly at the slash (`настройки/`), switching the system layout to Russian for the subsequent word.
  • Buffer & Raw Keystroke Synchronization**: Synchronized raw keystroke tracking with destination word accumulation in `WordBuffer`, preventing raw buffer residue upon buffer resets (e.g. typing a slash or digits on an empty buffer). Fixes the bug where auto-correcting a word following a slash sent an extra Backspace that deleted the preceding slash (`настройкиразработки` → `настройки/разработки`).
  • Accurate Deletion Range**: Eliminated double-counting of trailing punctuation in auto-correction backspace calculations, guaranteeing that only the typed characters belonging to the word and its trail are erased.
  • Punctuation Key Preservation**: Refined `nextBufferChar` to preserve genuine punctuation keys (such as `/`) as typed when neither the source nor the destination mapping is an alphabetic letter.

item.title: UniKloSwitcher 1.5.4
item.description:
Fixed

  • Preposition & Short-Word Chaining**: Fixed a regression where unanchored candidate short words (e.g. `nj` → `то`, `d` → `в`) were prematurely discarded from memory upon buffer reset instead of being preserved for contextual conversion with the following word (`nj есть` → `то есть`).

item.title: UniKloSwitcher 1.5.5
item.description:
Fixed

  • Contextual Chaining & Mutual Confirmation for Short Words**: Fixed an issue where phrases starting with multiple short words (such as `z nen` → `я тут` or `z nen поправил` → `я тут поправил`) were blocked from converting. Recognized 3-letter prepositions, particles, and adverbs in `ShortWords` (e.g. `тут`, `где`, `как`, `для`, `под`, `над`) are now properly classified as short-word candidates instead of being routed through the strict trigram garbage threshold. Consecutive recognized short words now mutually confirm the target language and convert immediately together, switching the system layout without requiring an extra long word.
  • Symmetric Latin Short-Word Registry**: Expanded `ShortWords.latin` with common 3-letter words (`the`, `and`, `for`, `you`, `not`, etc.) to symmetrically guard against false-positive conversions on English typing and support reverse chaining from Cyrillic layout.
